analysis.headline: USD/KRW surges 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 on KOSPI drop; 1M NDF eases to 1,339.9
analysis.summary: USD/KRW jumped 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 in Seoul (ECB 1,348.9) as KOSPI fell 3.31% to 4,708.54 with a sell sidecar and 7th day of foreign outflows, touching 1,351.6 before exporter sales. Overnight Nasdaq (+6.51%) cooled 1M NDF to 1,339.9 while DXY held near 103.9.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW advances to 1,475.5 on won slide despite mixed Eurozone PMIs
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW rose to around 1,475.5 (ECB ref 1,475.51). The Eurozone Nov flash Composite PMI held at 51.7 on German factory strength (52.9), yet France's manufacturing slump to 47.9 kept EUR/USD pinned near 1.093–1.094 while Seoul's won drop to 1,345.9 lifted the cross.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW rises to 847.9 per 100 JPY despite holiday yen dip past 159
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW moved up to around 847.9 per 100 JPY (ECB ref 8.479). With Tokyo closed for Labour Thanksgiving Day, higher US yields (4.96%) lifted USD/JPY to 158.9–159.3 despite Dec BoJ hike bets and intervention risk, while Seoul's won drop to 1,345.9 pushed the cross up.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW gains to 1,763.4 as KRW slide offsets softer UK flash PMI
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW climbed to around 1,763.4 (ECB ref 1,763.42). UK Nov flash Composite PMI eased to 52.3 (Services 52.0, Manufacturing 52.7), nudging GBP/USD down to 1.303–1.307 against a firm dollar, though Seoul's won depreciation to 1,345.9 drove the cross higher.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW climbs to 202.4 as Seoul won drop outweighs 6.7120 PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW rose to around 202.4 (ECB ref 202.39). Although the PBOC nudged its USD/CNY midpoint stronger to 6.7120 and spot yuan held steady near 6.66–6.67 amid Asian equity stabilization efforts, Seoul's 9.7 KRW surge in USD/KRW to 1,345.9 lifted the cross.

AUD.headline: AUD edges down to 892.5 KRW as November flash Composite PMI tumbles to 46.1
AUD.brief: AUD eased to 892.5 KRW as Nov flash Composite PMI fell to 46.1 (lowest since 2021), pulling AUD/USD near 0.662 despite KRW weakness.

CAD.headline: CAD rises to 939.2 KRW on won drop despite 3.9% WTI oil slump to $80.14
CAD.brief: CAD rose to 939.2 KRW on Seoul won weakness (1,345.9) even as WTI fell 3.9% to $80.14 on supply worries and USD/CAD stayed near 1.436.

CHF.headline: CHF rises past 1,606.3 KRW on firmer EUR/CHF (0.9186) and Seoul won drop
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc rose to 1,606.3 KRW as lingering geopolitical caution lifted EUR/CHF to 0.9186 alongside Seoul's 9.7 KRW jump in USD/KRW to 1,345.9.

CNY.headline: CNY tops 202.4 KRW on Seoul won slide despite firmer 6.7120 PBOC midpoint
CNY.brief: The yuan topped 202.4 KRW as Seoul's 9.7 KRW jump in USD/KRW to 1,345.9 outweighed a firmer 6.7120 PBOC midpoint and steady 6.66 spot.

EUR.headline: EUR advances to 1,475.5 KRW on won slide despite France PMI contraction
EUR.brief: The euro rose to 1,475.5 KRW; France's factory PMI drop to 47.9 capped EUR/USD near 1.094, while Seoul's won slide to 1,345.9 lifted it.

GBP.headline: GBP climbs to 1,763.4 KRW on KRW weakness despite UK PMI easing to 52.3
GBP.brief: Sterling gained to 1,763.4 KRW as Seoul's won drop to 1,345.9 offset UK flash Composite PMI easing to 52.3 and GBP/USD softening to 1.303–1.307.

HKD.headline: HKD climbs to 172.0 KRW tracking USD/KRW's 9.7 KRW jump to 1,345.9
HKD.brief: Pegged near 7.841 per USD inside its 7.75–7.85 band, the Hong Kong dollar climbed to 172.0 KRW in lockstep with Seoul USD/KRW jumping to 1,345.9.

JPY.headline: JPY rises to 847.9 per 100 JPY on won drop despite holiday yen dip past 159
JPY.brief: JPY rose to 847.9 KRW per 100 JPY as Seoul's won slide to 1,345.9 outweighed USD/JPY hitting 158.9–159.3 in Tokyo's holiday session.

KRW.headline: KRW slides 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 as KOSPI drops 3.3%; 1M NDF rebounds to 1,339.9
KRW.brief: The won fell 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 on KOSPI's 3.31% drop and a 7th day of foreign selling, before Nasdaq's +6.51% surge pulled 1M NDF down to 1,339.9.

USD.headline: USD jumps 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 in Seoul on 4.96% US yield; DXY near 103.9
USD.brief: USD/KRW surged 9.7 KRW to 1,345.9 in Seoul (ECB 1,348.9) as 4.96% 10Y yields and Fed bets kept DXY near 103.9 despite Wall St's rally.
